changes.reason: Owner-requested Roach Synth performance update: Compact Play/tempo and independent animation/sound preset rows, permanent direct 3D gestures, compact knob events, and one Low KAL16 voice with a Speed knob and quieter initial voice level; remove pose, voice selection and separate Sound Play controls while preserving Audio, MIDI, output levels and live clock.

Owner-requested Roach Synth performance update: Native Low KAL16 sentence rendering and bounded cached body syllables with cancellation, worker termination, explicit Audio activation, audio-clock utterance expiry telemetry and worklet-owned playback.

Owner-requested Roach Synth performance update: Motion-owned Low KAL16 voice syllables as body sources, bounded independent sample players, source crossfades, adjustable voice speed and release behavior.
Owner-requested Roach Synth performance update: The shared Low KAL16 Voicesaurus preset and its body sound assignment, migrating retired voice sources while preserving anatomical group ownership.

Owner-requested Roach Synth performance update: Raise master volume range to 100%, increase useful preset output with a bounded stereo reconstruction guard, retain numeric smoothing, and play Low KAL16 speech through the existing audio-clock processor with independent speed, duration telemetry and quieter default voice level. Retire upright animation sounds while preserving every retained companion's original articulation and voice speed.

Owner-requested Roach Synth performance update: Replace removed pose/Sound Play macro actions with consolidated Play and independent animation/sound selectors, remove voice selection and add voice speed while keeping existing MIDI gesture ownership.

Owner-requested Roach Synth performance update: Honor the expanded 2–4,400 BPM UI range in normalized settings and every beat, animation-track and ground-contact timing path; retire four upright dances and six standing poses from live banks while preserving saved frozen poses, grounded movement, jumps and flight.
